description.text:
One of the two expansions that opened the XY BREAK series on 26 September 2015, released together with Red Flash. Its illustrations show Pokémon in a town rich in nature, against Red Flash's town of the near future. Mega Mewtwo X and Y were split between the two packs, each with its own Mewtwo-EX, and since both share a name either Mewtwo-EX can become either Mega. Blue Shock holds M Mewtwo-EX X, Zoroark BREAK, Florges BREAK, Glalie-EX and M Glalie-EX, and Parallel City, the first Stadium with two effects. Packs held five cards. The cards are numbered to 59, followed by full-art Super Rare Pokémon-EX and Brigette and an Ultra Rare gold Mewtwo-EX. In English it became part of BREAKthrough in November 2015, together with Red Flash.

The series brought BREAK Evolution. A BREAK card is printed sideways, with the Pokémon drawn in gold across the whole card, and it lets a Pokémon evolve one step past its usual last stage. It keeps the attacks, Abilities, Weakness, Resistance and Retreat Cost of the card beneath it and takes its own HP and type. Because Zoroark BREAK has a different name from Zoroark, a deck can hold four of each.
